title: Bruno Kramm, German Goth Musician Who Moonlighted in Politics, Dies at 58
summary: When he wasn’t playing with the groundbreaking dark-wave band Das Ich, he was a prominent figure in his country’s fight for online free speech and digital privacy rights.
